description: This is a C source file implementing core functions for an ATM driver, including device initialization, data handling, and hardware interaction for a Linux-based embedded system.

methods.name: ppe_ioctl
methods.description: Handles IOCTL commands for ATM device, providing MIB data and VCC info.

methods.name: ppe_open
methods.description: Opens an ATM VCC, allocates resources, and sets up hardware parameters.

methods.name: ppe_close
methods.description: Closes an ATM VCC, releasing resources and updating hardware state.

methods.name: ppe_send
methods.description: Sends data over an ATM VCC, preparing descriptors and managing buffers.

methods.name: ppe_send_oam
methods.description: Sends OAM cells over an ATM VCC.

methods.name: ppe_change_qos
methods.description: Changes QoS parameters for an ATM VCC.

methods.name: set_qsb
methods.description: Configures QSB parameters for a VCC based on QoS.

methods.name: qsb_global_set
methods.description: Sets global QSB parameters.

methods.name: set_htu_entry
methods.description: Configures HTU entries for VCC routing.

methods.name: clear_htu_entry
methods.description: Clears HTU entries.

methods.name: validate_oam_htu_entry
methods.description: Enables OAM HTU entries.

methods.name: invalidate_oam_htu_entry
methods.description: Disables OAM HTU entries.

methods.name: find_vpi
methods.description: Finds connection index by VPI.

methods.name: find_vpivci
methods.description: Finds connection index by VPI and VCI.

methods.name: find_vcc
methods.description: Finds connection index by vcc pointer.

methods.name: ifx_atm_version
methods.description: Retrieves ATM firmware version info.

methods.name: check_parameters
methods.description: Validates and adjusts configuration parameters.

methods.name: init_priv_data
methods.description: Initializes private data structures and hardware descriptors.

methods.name: clear_priv_data
methods.description: Clears and frees private data structures.

methods.name: init_rx_tables
methods.description: Initializes receive descriptor tables and HTU entries.

methods.name: init_tx_tables
methods.description: Initializes transmit descriptor tables.

methods.name: ltq_atm_probe
methods.description: Device probe function, initializes hardware and registers ATM devices.

methods.name: ltq_atm_remove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up ATM device.
